To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) Collocations extracted from MEDLINE citations are useful for improving the quality of an automatic MEDLINE corpus used to train a Naïve Bayes algorithm for UMLS Metatheasaurus disambiguation.
the combination of different methods of collocation extraction and filtering of citations improves the quality of an automatic corpus.
1. We present a new approach for improving the quality of an existing corpus used for training a Naive-Bayes WSD classifier.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the automatic extraction of a training corpus for knowledge-based WSD.
the automatic extraction of training data for knowledge based WSD systems, which are not limited to a specific domain or entity.
the improvement of the quality of an automatic extracted corpus using related words.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of different methods of corpus extraction, including collocation extraction, and post filtering of the retrieved citations improves WSD performance.
we have shown that it is possible to obtain a corpus of citations for a specific term from MEDLINE without any human annotation.
our method is the most accurate knowledge based WSD method for disambiguating the UMLS Metathesarus.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of left side collocations with a post filtering step of retrieved citations achieves the best performance.
we can achieve an accuracy of 82.4% without any manual annotation, while the best accuracy achieved by other knowledge based methods was 78.3%.
the use of collocations in combination with the automatic corpus extraction approach improves the performance of the WSD system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
collocations can be used to improve the quality of an automatic MEDLINE corpus.
the use of related terms in combination with the UMLS can help in the disambiguration of ambiguous terms.
we have achieved the best result for UMLS metathesaurus disambiguation with no manually annotated data.
